source_reader: Third-party text/JSON extractor of public official API; no unmodified origin HTTP response bytes/headers retained

tool_client_envelope_utc.meaning: Tool orchestration start/end only; not exact individual request or original server timestamps

comparison_method: Parse accessible JSON representation returned for each schema_response ID, compare all revision_responses values by JSON structural equality, field for field

latest.revision_justification: Added links to supporting research materials and clarified their descriptions. No changes were made to the preregistered study design, hypotheses, sampling, or analysis plan.

changed_field.label: Other planned analysis (as labelled in supplied OSF Overview)
changed_field.original_value:
Secondary exploratory analyses may examine unexpected state transitions, new aggregation patterns, platform-specific anomalies, or infrastructure behaviors not covered by the preregistered primary questions.

Any such analyses will be clearly labeled exploratory or post hoc and will not be presented as preregistered findings.
changed_field.revised_value:
Secondary exploratory or post hoc analyses may include contextual benchmarking of software concept families, bounded sensitivity checks across platform-provided engagement metrics, and tie-aware rank or percentile summaries. Additional analyses may examine unexpected state transitions, aggregation patterns, query or interface anomalies, and other platform-specific behaviors.

Analyses introduced after the original registration will remain explicitly labeled exploratory or post hoc and will not be presented as preregistered primary findings.

interpretation_limits: Comparison covers only revision_responses values, not attachments, resources, OSF registries internal lifecycle, or exact original HTTP bytes
Creation/submission/modified timestamps are platform fields and do not independently establish when every wording was publicly effective
A later approved exploratory/post-hoc wording is not a preregistered initial primary analysis
No concrete numerical schedule offsets found in the 29 original revision fields
The revision justification describes a claimed purpose and is not a substitute for observed field-level differences
